projects.title: Friendship in every bottle
projects.description:
Bodrumi i Vjetër is the most famous winery in Kosovo, which was founded in 1950 as a publicly owned enterprise.

Bodrumi i Vjetër continues to preserve the tradition and produce wines of high geographical genesis in accordance with European standards.

We managed the social networks of Bodrumi i Vjetër, always promoting their products and highlighting the characteristics of the wines through facts and creative posts.

During 2021, the European Union invested in sophisticated machinery, which helped this wine improve in quality.

Bodrumi i Vjetër wanted to make this known to the general public…
